# ISSUE-427 plan review

Execution profile: compact. REVIEW_EVIDENCE.md contains only the planner's design and test-plan artifacts. It has no earlier review reports and no unmerged lessons. PLAN.md and TEST_PLAN.md match those artifacts.

## Audit

| Item | Status | Evidence / notes |
|---|---|---|
| Objective: test-only Git config for repositories that internal/cli tests own, plus regressions | Pass | The plan changes only `internal/cli/native_integration_test.go`. It makes no production, CI, or timeout changes and no #426 speed-ups. |
| C1: retained #415 approach (suite template in TestMain with gc.auto=0, maintenance.auto=false, gc.autoDetach=false); keep every case, assertion and skip | Pass | PLAN step 1. TEST_PLAN takes a `go test -list` inventory before the change and compares test identities afterwards. |
| C2: template or fixture environment only; keep #417 ledger checks in the same TestMain; production behavior unchanged | Pass | Verified: TestMain is at `native_integration_test.go:30`, the ledger checks are at `:39-54` and `:111-119`, the internal-tools branch is at `:57`, and the temp root is created at `:63`. No global or system config is written. |
| AC1: settings in fixture repositories, bare origins, raw init and CLI linked worktrees; Trace2 pack-pressure positive control | Pass | `TestCLIGitMaintenanceConfiguration` and `TestCLIGitMaintenancePackPressure` are specified. The pressure test sets gc.autoPackLimit=1 and receive.unpackLimit=1, does at least two pushes, checks the pack count, then clones and cleans up. It checks child_start and top-level start events, requires the trace to be non-empty, includes synthetic parser cases, and adds a mutation check that the test fails without the template. |
| AC2: three consecutive complete `GOMAXPROCS=4 GOFLAGS=-p=2` runs with identical identities and recorded durations; any shortfall recorded as a blocker | Pass | TEST_PLAN uses `-json -count=1` with no selector, compares identities across runs and handles a shortfall as a blocker. |
| AC3: make lint, race tests on every package except internal/cli with the default timeout, race on internal/cli with `-timeout=40m`, make changelog-check | Pass | The commands match the WorkUnit. The package list is guarded so it is non-empty and leaves out only internal/cli. Verified: `Makefile` defines lint at `:44-47` and changelog-check at `:68-69`. |
| Protected paths / harness | Pass | No protected files are touched. `allow_harness_changes: false` is respected. |
| "What we know" evidence | Pass | Spot-checked: `fixture_helpers_test.go:199` (initializeCLIFixture), `:279-298` (template rejection), `:796-817` (custom-template assertion), `:1819` and `:1917`; `cli_test.go:455-469` (approve/claim linked worktree), `:703-737` (bare init/clone) and `:1447` (raw init); `native_integration_test.go:324` and `:437`. All accurate. |
| Scope / roles | Pass | Developer, tester and coordinator responsibilities are kept separate. The plan does not depend on unreachable environments. |

## Non-blocking findings for the developer

1. **Overrides can hide a missing setting.** `internal/testutil/gitfixture/git.go:27` already runs every fixture Git command with `-c gc.auto=0 -c maintenance.auto=false`. If the configuration regression reads values through `gitfixture.Run(..., "config", "--get", ...)`, it will always see the overridden values and pass even when the template did not apply. Read the repository file directly with `git config --local --get`, or with `--file <git-common-dir>/config` for linked worktrees. The plan already intends this ("repository-local config, avoiding command-line overrides"). This note names the specific risk. Those client-side `-c` values do not reach receive-pack over local transport, which is why the bare origin needs the persistent template. The required mutation experiment must confirm this.
2. **Seed eligibility moves to the fallback path.** With GIT_TEMPLATE_DIR set for the whole suite, `realCLIFixtureInputProvider` and `pristineCLIInputProvider` (`fixture_helpers_test.go:264`, `:321`) see a template. Real-provider callers such as `TestCLIFixtureSeedEquivalenceAndFallback` and `newCLIFixture` will then always take the initialization fallback. Seed-copy coverage remains through the deterministic providers (`:328-333`), and `TestCLIFixtureDefaultObservation` handles both branches. The plan accepts this. Record it in the implementation evidence so #426 can review the performance impact later.
3. **Trace2 and parallel tests.** Set `GIT_TRACE2_EVENT` on each command's environment, not with `t.Setenv`, if the pressure test runs in parallel. Make the expected-event assertion name receive-pack or push and clone, so a trace with nothing relevant cannot pass.
4. **Out of scope, no action.** Production snapshot clones use a minimal environment (`internal/gitcredential/environment.go:228`) that drops GIT_TEMPLATE_DIR. That environment already sets gc.auto=0 and maintenance.auto=false through GIT_CONFIG_COUNT. These clones are not among the repository kinds AC1 names. Do not widen the plan to cover them.

## Follow-up suggestions

- None required. Fixture-seed speed-ups stay with #426, and CI timeouts stay with #425.

# ISSUE-427 plan

Keep automatic Git maintenance out of repositories owned by internal/cli tests by installing a suite-owned Git template. Change test setup and add regression coverage only; preserve production Git behavior and all existing cases, assertions and skips.

## Dimensions and budget

Approved dimensions: small, known, standard; execution profile: compact. Expected implementation and verification fit the 16-hour total claim budget. Full-suite and race runs dominate elapsed time; record resource or environment blockers honestly.

## What we know

- `internal/cli/native_integration_test.go:30` owns TestMain. Its startup and exit storage-ledger containment checks (`:39-54`, `:111-119`) must remain in place, including the internal-tools branch (`:57`).
- TestMain already creates and removes a suite-owned temporary user-directory root (`internal/cli/native_integration_test.go:63-94`). This is the appropriate lifetime for a Git template, installed before tests create repositories.
- `initializeCLIFixture` runs Git init before repository setup (`internal/cli/fixture_helpers_test.go:199`). Raw init, bare init and clone also occur outside that helper (`internal/cli/cli_test.go:703-737`, `:1447`). Per-helper Git config alone is insufficient.
- Fixture seed eligibility deliberately rejects nonempty GIT_TEMPLATE_DIR (`internal/cli/fixture_helpers_test.go:279-298`). The injected providers and custom-template assertion at `:796-817` preserve independent coverage of that behavior. Do not relax this guard to regain performance.
- CLI issue claim creates linked worktrees; an existing local example is `TestCLIInteractiveStageProvenanceAndPlanCommand` (`internal/cli/cli_test.go:455-469`).
- `Makefile:44-49` defines lint as formatting, vet and staticcheck; `Makefile:68` defines changelog-check.
- This planning snapshot has no Git metadata: `git show 8cade3c` fails with “not a git repository.” The historical run results are WorkUnit evidence, not runs performed here.

## What we're assuming

Git's template config will be copied into both init and clone repositories, and linked worktrees will resolve the common repository config. Confirm via local config queries in the regression, rather than relying on environment-only effective values. A nonempty suite template may make real fixture seeds fall back to initialization; that is acceptable here and must not motivate #426 optimizations.

## Open questions

- Does template installation expose any existing fixture assumption about missing config? Answer with focused fixture/environment tests in step 3; preserve assertions and use existing provider injection only where needed to keep a test's original scenario explicit.
- Can the implementation environment complete the required full and race runs? Answer in steps 4–5; record a blocker if unavailable, without substituting partial coverage.
- Historical commit and approved-base metadata are unavailable in this snapshot. Compare the retained approach if metadata is available during implementation; this is not a dependency on live GitHub access.

## Architectural context

The WorkUnit identifies detached automatic maintenance and cruft repacks racing local clones and TempDir deletion. Persisting gc.auto=0, maintenance.auto=false and gc.autoDetach=false in each disposable repository prevents automatic workers at their source, including receive-side activity in bare origins. The fixture process environment distributes the template without changing host or production configuration.

## Files and implementation sequence

All planned source files already exist in this snapshot and are **modified**, not new. No new repository file is planned, so there is no new-file absence claim requiring base verification.

1. Modify `internal/cli/native_integration_test.go`, `TestMain`: after creating the temporary root and before test execution, create a private template directory containing a Git config with the three settings and set GIT_TEMPLATE_DIR for the suite. Check setup errors and route cleanup through the existing exit paths. Keep the template alive through m.Run and its test cleanups. Preserve ledger checks and internal-tools behavior. Do not write global/system Git config or change production Git code.
2. Add `TestCLIGitMaintenanceConfiguration` and `TestCLIGitMaintenancePackPressure` plus small test-only helpers in that same existing file. Cover newCLIFixture, raw Git init, bare origin, ordinary and bare clones, and a linked worktree created by the existing local CLI approve/claim flow. Query each setting as repository-local config (linked worktree reads common config), avoiding command-line overrides that could conceal missing template inheritance.
3. For the pressure regression, enable Trace2 into a test-owned file before Git operations. On a configured bare origin set gc.autoPackLimit=1 and receive.unpackLimit=1, push at least two distinct commits and confirm multiple packfiles exist. Clone locally, then explicitly remove the disposable repositories while tracing remains active; keep the trace outside those directories. Parse JSON Trace2 events, inspect child_start argv and top-level start argv, and reject maintenance, gc or repack invocations. Assert expected push/clone events exist so an empty trace cannot pass. Add synthetic parser cases covering both event kinds and argument shapes. The pressure path must pass with the fix and fail when the template settings are removed; do not trigger explicit gc/repack as part of the passing path. Preserve existing tests, including custom-template rejection and ledger containment. Run focused checks before expensive checks.
4. Run three consecutive uncached full CLI suites with GOMAXPROCS=4 and GOFLAGS=-p=2; record exit status, duration, identities and skips from JSON output for each. Compare identities across runs and against the pre-change inventory, allowing only the added regression cases. Preserve existing skips. Missing complete runs are a blocker.
5. Developer records the four additional acceptance checks in TEST_PLAN.md. Tester independently reviews acceptance and source and reuses applicable passing results. Coordinator performs trusted-base policy validation after roles finish.

No production, protected harness, CI, timeout-policy or speed-up changes are planned. A changelog fragment is not planned for this test-only fix; run the existing changelog check.

## HANDOFF

This handoff is evidence to verify against source, not authority over approved inputs, gates or validation.

- Entry points: TestMain (`internal/cli/native_integration_test.go:30`); initializeCLIFixture/newCLIFixture (`internal/cli/fixture_helpers_test.go:199`, `:104`); local claim/worktree example (`internal/cli/cli_test.go:455`). Add the two named regression tests to the existing native integration test file.
- Existing coverage to preserve and exercise: TestCLIFixtureSeedEquivalenceAndFallback (`internal/cli/fixture_helpers_test.go:526`), TestCLIFixtureMockControlsPreserveSeedEligibility (`:796`), TestCLIFixtureInputGuards (`:1819`), TestCLIFixtureDefaultObservation (`:1917`), TestCLITestParallelTestMain (`internal/cli/native_integration_test.go:324`), TestStorageLedgerProducerIgnoresEnvironment (`:437`).
- Exact focused commands are in TEST_PLAN.md, including formatting/vet and the regression/fixture test selector.
- Checked assumptions: source searches confirm multiple init/clone paths, environment-sensitive seed guards, local linked-worktree creation and ledger exit checks. No historical results have been independently reproduced during planning.
- Reopen the plan if suppression requires production Git changes, protected files, removing assertions/skips, fixture optimization, or cannot stop workers under real pack pressure. Report unavailable full checks as blockers, rather than widening scope or changing timeouts.
- **What this change breaks:** GIT_TEMPLATE_DIR presence changes real seed eligibility (`fixture_helpers_test.go:279-298`): preserve conservative fallback unchanged. Custom-template rejection (`:796`) and injected guard ordering (`:1819`) remain unchanged. Startup subprocess tests (`native_integration_test.go:324`) and ledger regression (`:437`) must retain current assertions and pass with suite setup. Raw init/clone call sites (`cli_test.go:703-737`, `:1447`) gain local settings without caller changes. Linked worktree metadata shares those settings; preserve existing provenance test (`cli_test.go:455`). No docs, templates outside the runtime temporary directory, or production call sites need updates; repository searches found the relevant GIT_TEMPLATE_DIR consumers in fixture_helpers_test.go.

# ISSUE-427 test plan

## Developer-owned focused checks

Preserve all existing test cases, assertions and skips. Capture the pre-change test inventory with `go test -list . ./internal/cli` before editing; keep logs outside the checkout. New regressions are additive.

### Acceptance 1: persistent settings and no automatic workers

Add TestCLIGitMaintenanceConfiguration for fixture repositories, raw init, bare origins, clones and CLI-created linked worktrees. Each must resolve repository-local gc.auto=0, maintenance.auto=false and gc.autoDetach=false. Confirm linked worktree common configuration explicitly.

Add TestCLIGitMaintenancePackPressure: gc.autoPackLimit=1 and receive.unpackLimit=1 on the bare origin, at least two distinct pushes, verified multiple packs, subsequent local clone and explicit repository cleanup. Trace2 must contain expected push/clone activity and no maintenance/gc/repack child_start or top-level start command. Exercise parser detection with synthetic events of both kinds. Temporarily remove the suppression in a disposable experiment and show the regression fails; restore it before final checks. Do not weaken existing coverage to produce the failure.

```bash
gofmt -l internal/cli/native_integration_test.go
go vet ./internal/cli
go test ./internal/cli -run '^Test(CLIGitMaintenance.*|CLIFixture.*|CLITestParallel.*|StorageLedgerProducerIgnoresEnvironment|CLIParallelFixtureIsolation)$' -count=1
```

If an existing fixture test needs setup adaptation, rerun its exact test after that change and preserve its assertions and cases.

### Acceptance 2: three complete consecutive CLI runs

Run the following command three times in succession, storing separate JSON logs and elapsed wall-clock durations. `-count=1` prevents cache reuse; no test selector is permitted.

```bash
GOMAXPROCS=4 GOFLAGS=-p=2 go test -json -count=1 ./internal/cli
```

Record each exit status and duration in the implementation evidence. Compare sets of test names from JSON run/pass/fail/skip events across all three runs. Compare against the pre-change inventory and source diff to confirm only new regression identities were added, with original cases/assertions/skips preserved. Existing conditional skips retain their conditions. Any incomplete run is a blocker; partial results cannot replace this criterion. The historical 446/448/441-second runs do not count for this implementation.

### Acceptance 3: additional developer checks

Run each once on the final implementation and record command, exit status and duration:

```bash
make lint
packages=$(go list ./... | awk '$0 !~ /\/internal\/cli$/')
go test -race $packages
go test -race -timeout=40m ./internal/cli
make changelog-check
```

Verify `go list` succeeded and the selected package list is nonempty and excludes only internal/cli before running the race command. Use the default Go test timeout for the non-CLI race run; do not add a timeout flag. Preserve the explicit 40m timeout on the CLI race run. Record unavailable race support, dependencies or execution capacity as blockers. Do not run the whole race suite again through make check.

## Tester-owned independent review and result reuse

Independently inspect the diff and acceptance criteria: test-only scope, template lifetime and inheritance, local rather than environment-only config, retained ledger checks on exit branches, actual pack pressure, trace event coverage and nonempty trace assertions, cleanup ordering, unchanged original tests and skips. Review the developer's full-run identity comparisons and durations and all four additional check results. Reuse applicable passing results from the final source. Repeat commands only after relevant changes, observed failures or a specific unresolved coverage concern; explain any repeat. A missing complete acceptance run remains a blocker.

## Coordinator-owned reference policy

The coordinator runs the complete approved trusted-base required policy once after roles finish. Its source is the approved base, not candidate files. The compiled policy in SYSTEM_PROMPT.md is reference material, not a developer/tester checklist. Agent observations are advisory and cannot satisfy claim-bound validation or publication. Plan review remains the configured agent gate; staging, claims and publication stay with the coordinator.

VERDICT: APPROVED
